title: Conditional κ = .00389821040 (+0.00000128263987% over #8062; +0.00001026111985% over #8057): lower the signed Gaussian cutoff
body:
## Verified result

**Conditional κ = 0.00389821040.** The absolute gain over independently reproduced [#8062](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/8062), at **0.00389821035**, is **0.00000000005**, or **(100/77964207)%**. The absolute gain over the latest [external peer science](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/tree/cbe847a953b971f9c6c5a0a6661e2008acd29086/research/frequency-weighted-native-multiplier) in #8057, at **0.00389821**, is **0.00000000040**, or **(4/389821)%**. The new rate clears the exact installed #8062 ceiling under the same five signed all-size interfaces.

The literal even cutoff moves from 2048 to 1874. Its finite factor, including both fringe charges, fits debit 64982/524288. Keeping the previous cutoff fails that debit. The exact first ordinary grants cover both parent widths 3748 and 3750, with child widths 1866 and 3732. Both signed budgets close at Gaussian H=483871 and ordinary H3=524369. The independent check rejects H3=524368. Recurring log₂ C≤318285351, the finite entry charges 514 bits, and fixed native tape setup remains conservatively bounded by 2^228. The portable setup measurement in #8057 is specific to that checkout.

## Reproduce

From the exact source checkout with Git and CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -IB scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-weighted-lower-band
```

All seven registered scopes passed in 167.38 seconds at `28af5f7ddda5c6b17d1ff33c8af28c7d1dbdb1d3`, including the eight literal cutoff grants, both signed widths, physical owner returns, the nested signed grant 4507783464, and signed product −345550037539. Release `682fd9512ccbf3035089d7e5f9cb4dedf9f746b4` changes one proof phrase and preserves the tested runtime and inputs. Exact metadata, committed bytes and modes, onboarding (760 tests, 31 skips), and the historical registered replay also passed. Independent detached checks reconstructed the 88 archived peer paths, old crossing, new finite factor, signed placement, setup, and insufficient-height control. The K7 receipt is reused with matching source and verifier hashes. The exact release passed every hosted check. [Actual seven-mode hosted scientific replay](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/45078647703/job/137382630514) · [Clean-checkout evidence](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/blob/bf7d249f4a657da09cb4eaf663dceb432bee3187/paired-768/r388/README.md)
